independence_audit.limitation: Arm 03 disclosed that a post-core repository-wide rg for a schema key traversed other current-run filenames and one matching schema-key line. It did not open or use another arm's prompt, pack, or image content, so generation inputs remain substantively separate, but the strict no-inspection protocol is not a clean pass. The coordinator later mapped concurrent tool outputs in the shared generated-images directory and sent each unmapped agent only its own path.
